nodes.label: voidHTTP App Icon
nodes.rationale: Rounded dark square (#0d0f14) with violet ring (#7c5cff) around teal-outlined dark core (#22d3a6) and two teal horizontal stubs left/right: a 'void' circle with a wire passing through, evoking request/response flow. Source for `npx tauri icon`.

nodes.label: OS Webview (WebKit on macOS)
nodes.rationale: Keeps app small by using the OS webview instead of bundling Chromium + Node runtime.

nodes.label: Postman Import (v2.0/v2.1 collections, environments)
nodes.rationale: Auth inheritance from Postman collections is flattened on import.

nodes.label: Zustand App State (store.ts)
nodes.rationale: Frontend state with debounced persistence to limit disk writes.

nodes.label: Atomic JSON Persistence (store.rs)
nodes.rationale: Writes workspace.json, history.json, session.json atomically in the app data dir (~/Library/Application Support/dev.voidhttp.app/ on macOS).

nodes.label: Local-First Design
nodes.rationale: No account, no cloud sync, no telemetry; user data is plain JSON on disk.

nodes.label: Rust HTTP Engine (http.rs)
nodes.rationale: Requests run in Rust so CORS does not apply, connections are pooled, and the UI thread never blocks. Handles pooled clients, cancellation, multipart.
